notes.subject: feat(approvals): align file rule editors and add one-click folder approval
notes.summary: File approval cards now share one rule editor with folder-prefix defaults, outside-workspace write cards keep their layout, rule patterns wrap, and a new Allow Folder for Session button approves a file's folder in one click.

notes.subject: feat(approvals): give the Guardian host-measured evidence for file restores
notes.summary: The Approve for Me Guardian now receives host-measured diffs and session-edit facts for git checkout/restore file reverts, so it can approve restoring a session's own edits without the agent printing the diff first.

47dea7cfcdeac25101b615a6671ea7c3f57d2b0a.summary: The /btw panel now supports follow-up questions in the side thread, replaces 'Add to conversation' with 'Send to chat' to send your message plus the side thread to the main agent, and raises per-question limits to 25 turns, 50 tool calls and 10 minutes.
